reviews.review: A great game with fun and nice level design, sadly it requires more marketing attention, also Workshop features will be fantastic. It's worth playing of course :D
Awesome free coop game with supporting workshop.

Underrated, underrated, underrated!

I love this game. Truly, I adore it. However, due to the lack of bots, I don't play it a lot. Seriously, I first got it to get the Team Fortress 2 hat. However, underneath the thought of hats you find a top-down shooter that requires a small level of planning. It's class-based with only two of each class, but you find that only one is actually essential to level completion. Unlike many games by Valve, you don't really give a damn about the characters you play as. The only difference is avatar and voice. No biggies, really.

However, to fully enjoy this game, PLAY IT WITH FRIENDS. OPEN SKYPE. DO THAT. I say this for many multiplayer campaign shooters, you may come across someone who will make you hate the game because they're telling you what to do, and not in the sense that they're actually being a leader. If you're with friends, you know your strengths, know how to communicate and know how to get stuff done.

I haven't played enough of Alien Swarm to go into detail, but it's free so you should get all your friends to join. Seriously. Good stuff.

This game is amazing. Not only is it the first free game on steam but its fun as hell and no one knows about it. Thank god. I don't want this game full of little kids bragging about their Alien Swarm Parasite hats.

Knock knock!  Who's there?  Alien!  Alien who?

[b][i]Irreverend Opinions[/i][/b] reviewing [b]Alien Swarm[/b], that's who!

[strike]---[/strike]

[h1]The Blurb[/h1]

A surprising freebie on Steam, which is actually a lot more fun that expected.  Alien Swarm follows the genre of the "alien monster" squad shooter, with a 2.5D tactical build.  Take control of one of four squad members with a particular specialty (heavy weapons, healing, etc) and kill bugs.

[h1]The Good[/h1]

The game is simple and robust, with a clean engine and UI.  Weapons are definitely manageable with a bit of variety beyond the skins.  Some decent execution of tactics can be encouraged, with fire lines and herding of aliens, which supports the tactically minded quite well.

The game ships with an open editor for custom maps, and modding is given pretty much a big thumbs up to encourage custom content.  Decent graphics quality (given it's a free game) and sound is well-developed with a good selection of stock components.  The game offers a gradual increase in challenge level, up to and including 'hardcore'.

[h1]The Bad[/h1]

It's short, and there's almost no plot to speak of, but can't complain about that in a decent-quality free game.  The challenge rating can be quite high, which can be a turn off for some players.

[h1]The ugly[/h1]

Mostly forgotten not long after being released, which can result in long, empty queues in multiplayer, which in turn means some later missions are nigh-impossible without assistance.

[h1]Suggestions[/h1]

Revamping this so it features more in the queue would be a good move by Valve (who made it).

[h1]The Summary[/h1]

7/10, though that's including it being free.
